## 🚨 EMERGENCY INTAKE SOURCES
Captures reports from Telegram, Gmail, Web Form, or CSV batch.

## 🧠 GROQ AI CLASSIFICATION
Evaluates whether message is a real/simulated disaster vs casual chat.

## 🔍 GROQ AI EXTRACTION
Extracts disaster type, location, casualties, and needed resources.

## 🔄 DEDUPLICATION & INCIDENT MERGING
Groups multi-channel reports into a consolidated operational incident.

## ⚖️ PRIORITY ENGINE & MONGODB
Calculates deterministic score and creates incident in database.

## 👮 HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP APPROVAL
Critical and High priority incidents require operator authorization.

## 📢 AUTOMATED MULTI-CHANNEL RESPONSE
Dispatches Telegram alert, Email notice, Response Task, and Audit Logs.
